new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

Before you wrap up the Paris booking, the London hotel for May 28–30 still needs to be locked in. Could you review the London options and reserve the one whose reviews explicitly mention River Thames views? Riverside View looks like the obvious choice. I'd appreciate getting this sorted first so we don't lose the dates.
